name: Portobello Burger Stack with Grilled Onions, Chimichurri & Asparagus

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunches asparagus
4 caps portobello mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small bunch cilantro
1 tomato

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until asparagus is fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings. Place on a large plate.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; add to the plate with the onions. Drizzle veggies with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, place mushrooms and onions on the pan. Grill until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in a small bowl and set aside; place the other half in a medium bowl.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the medium bowl with the herbs; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 4 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, place burger patties on the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, peel and mince garlic; add to the small bowl with the herbs, along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide asparagus and grilled mushrooms between plates. Layer each mushroom with a burger patty, tomato, and onions; spoon chimichurri over top and enjoy!
